stemMarkdown: Find the remainder when $93 \times 531$ is divided by $11$.
solutionMarkdown: Reduce each factor first: $93 \equiv 5$ and $531 \equiv 3 \pmod{11}$. So the product is $\equiv 5 \times 3 = 15 \equiv 4 \pmod{11}$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Reducing before multiplying keeps the numbers small — the remainder is unaffected.
